name: Dunkin' Toasted Sourdough Toast with Avocado Spread
whyItWorks: Thick slice of toasted sourdough bread topped with a smooth spread of ripe Hass avocado, sea salt, and a touch of lemon juice. Naturally fermented sourdough is easy to digest, and avocado provides soothing anti-inflammatory monounsaturated fats.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order: 'Avocado Toast—HOLD the Everything Bagel seasoning (avoid seeds and garlic).' Enjoy with hot tea.
